name: separate-opening-terms-v1
hypothesis: Opening kills and opening deaths may have asymmetric marginal effects; test freeing the equal-and-opposite coefficient constraint.
definition: Separate opening_kills/rounds and opening_deaths/rounds. All other available families use the original baseline, including kills beyond first. Objectives unavailable and excluded.
split: Same seven pre-August events (299 rows), leave-one-event-out, full-train evaluation on August EWC (32 rows). Both September events excluded; 60 final NA rows sealed.
decision: One variant only. Record fold errors, raw slopes and drift; no parameter search or final-test access. Preregistered before fitting.
